name: shadcn-zod-form
summary: CLI that converts Zod schemas into shadcn/ui forms, mapping each Zod type to the matching form component.
description: A command-line tool that generates shadcn/ui forms from Zod schemas: point it at a schema and it maps each Zod type to the appropriate form component, producing ready-to-use form code, with an easy-to-use CLI interface. The README documents features, installation, usage and contributing; the repository now lives under the arkemis-labs organisation (topics: react-hook-form, shadcn, zod).
contains: generates shadcn/ui forms from Zod schemas
maps Zod types to appropriate form components
README: features, installation, usage and contributing guide
MIT licensed; repository moved to arkemis-labs/shadcn-zod-form
